answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to grow each agent identity like an orchard: reputation is planted task by task and takes seasons to mature, so a new account cannot bear fruit overnight. A zephyr of bad behaviour — one bad trade, one failed check — is enough for peers to inspect the record, and misbehaviour prunes the standing built. A sparrow among thousands of fakes still has to climb the same slow growth, so spawning fakes costs far more than the access they would gain.
